title: Maltese legend of giants building the temples

tellings.quote: the Maltese legends in that area are that there were giants once on these islands and that they helped build these temples

plain: On the islands of Malta, local legend says giants once lived there and helped build the islands' ancient stone temples. A guest named Jay Anderson passes this on as what the Maltese say about the area, not as something he saw. If the legend kept a real memory, it would mean the temples' builders were remembered as something larger than ordinary people.
